arguments.sql: SELECT j.JRNL_NO, SUM(j.DR_AMT) AS dr, SUM(j.CR_AMT) AS cr, SUM(j.DR_AMT)-SUM(j.CR_AMT) AS diff FROM "GLJRNL" j GROUP BY j.JRNL_NO HAVING ABS(SUM(j.DR_AMT)-SUM(j.CR_AMT)) > 0.005 ORDER BY j.JRNL_NO

SELECT UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(i.VEND_CD),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) AS v, LTRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM(i.INV_NO)),'[^A-Z0-9]','','g'),'0') AS n, COUNT(*) AS c, ARRAY_AGG(i.INV_ID) AS ids FROM "APINVH" i GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1

SELECT i.INV_ID, i.INV_AMT, i.JRNL_NO, j.DR_AMT, j.CR_AMT, j.ACCT_CD FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNL" j ON j.JRNL_NO=i.JRNL_NO WHERE i.INV_AMT < 0 OR i.INV_AMT <> COALESCE(j.DR_AMT,0)+COALESCE(j.CR_AMT,0)-COALESCE(j.CR_AMT,0)*0 ORDER BY i.INV_ID

SELECT i.INV_ID, i.INV_AMT, h.PRD_ID, p.STAT_CD, p.CLOSE_DT, h.POST_DT, h.JRNL_NO FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h.JRNL_NO=i.JRNL_NO JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p.PRD_ID=h.PRD_ID WHERE p.STAT_CD='C' AND h.POST_DT > p.CLOSE_DT ORDER BY i.INV_ID
